source: Dates, price bands and issue sizes: IPO calendars (Angel One, ipomarket.in, Chittorgarh) and company announcements. Subscription: Chittorgarh and HDFC Sky at the close of bidding. Listing dates are tentative until the exchanges confirm them.
description: Jio Platforms opens for subscription on 21 October 2026. At ₹30,213 crore it is the largest IPO by size reported in India. Listing is tentatively scheduled for 28 October.
highlights: 27 crore equity shares on offer; ₹28,755 crore at the lower end of the band
Minimum bid 12 shares, about ₹13,428 at the upper band
Red herring prospectus filed on 14 October 2026
